snippet.title: EDEN'S FRONTIER — Blu’s First Beta Gameplay
snippet.description:
We hope you enjoy this small look at what we’re building. This is Bleumites’ Cave, only a small part of the world of EDEN’S FRONTIER, our indie action RPG for PC. BETA PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE OPEN.

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3397010/EDENS_FRONTIER/

This underground area reveals a mysterious cave, as if its glowing mineral formations and fungal creatures had taken possession of the place itself, creating a heavier atmosphere. This trailer shows a short gameplay sequence through the cave, featuring enemy encounters and real-time combat, all captured from our playable build.

EDEN’S FRONTIER is an indie action RPG, blending HD pixel art, 3D environments, real-time battles, exploration, a card-based system, and an original story that also expands through our webcomic.

Official website:
https://edensfrontier.com/

Read the webcomic:
https://edensfrontier.com/manga-online-1-en/

The game is inspired by the spirit of 90s and 2000s RPGs and adventure games, while also drawing creative influence from works we love, including Final Fantasy, Ragnarok Online, Sonic the Hedgehog, Chrono Trigger, Digimon, Zelda, Dragon Quest, among others.

Thank you for watching.

#EdensFrontier #IndieGame #ActionRPG #PixelArt #Gameplay #IndieRPG
